headings.title: Elements of arson in the first degree
headings.reviewNote: Defines first degree arson as knowingly damaging a building or inhabitable structure by fire or explosion endangering persons or during methamphetamine production.

headings.title: Classification and class A felony enhancement
headings.reviewNote: Classifies first degree arson as a class B felony, enhanced to class A if serious physical injury or death results.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and effective date (1-01-17) for 569.040. Verified accuracy of first-degree arson elements (including methamphetamine production) and class B/A felony classifications.

headings.title: Elements of arson in the second degree
headings.reviewNote: Defines second degree arson as knowingly damaging a building or inhabitable structure by starting a fire or causing an explosion.

headings.title: Defenses for lawful purpose and exclusive ownership or consent
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a defense where no other person has an interest or all interested persons consented and damage was for a lawful purpose.

headings.title: Burden of injecting defense on defendant
headings.reviewNote: Places the burden of injecting the issue of lawful purpose and consent upon the defendant.

headings.title: Classification and class B felony enhancement
headings.reviewNote: Classifies second degree arson as a class D felony, enhanced to class B if serious physical injury or death results.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all four subsections and effective date (1-01-17) for 569.050. Verified accuracy of second-degree arson elements, lawful-purpose/consent defense, defendant injection burden, and class D/B felony penalties.

headings.title: Elements of arson in the third degree
headings.reviewNote: Defines third degree arson as knowingly starting a fire or explosion and recklessly damaging or destroying another's building or structure.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies third degree arson as a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and effective date (1-01-17) for 569.053. Verified accuracy of third-degree arson elements and class A misdemeanor classification.

headings.title: Elements of knowingly burning or exploding
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of knowingly burning or exploding as knowingly damaging property of another by starting a fire or explosion.

headings.title: Class E felony classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies knowingly burning or exploding as a class E felony.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and effective date (1-01-17) for 569.055. Verified accuracy of knowingly burning or exploding elements and class E felony classification.

headings.title: Elements of reckless burning or exploding
headings.reviewNote: Defines reckless burning or exploding as recklessly starting a fire or explosion damaging or destroying another's property.

headings.title: Class B misdemeanor classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies reckless burning or exploding as a class B misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and effective date (1-01-17) for 569.060. Verified accuracy of reckless burning or exploding elements and class B misdemeanor classification.

headings.title: Elements of negligent burning or exploding
headings.reviewNote: Defines negligent burning or exploding as criminally negligent property or land damage caused by fire, explosion, or escaped fire.

headings.title: Class C misdemeanor classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies negligent burning or exploding as a class C misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and effective date (1-01-17) for 569.065. Verified accuracy of negligent burning or exploding elements (including escaped fires) and class C misdemeanor classification.

headings.title: Elements of possessing tool to break into vending machine
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of possessing a tool, key, or device with intent to steal from a coin-operated vending or payment-activated machine.

headings.title: Civil cause of action, treble damages, and attorney's fees
headings.reviewNote: Permits machine owners to bring a civil action against any person found guilty of a violation, with discretionary treble damages, attorney's fees, and costs.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies possession of a tool to break into a vending machine as a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all three subsections, transfer note (formerly § 578.445), and effective date (1-01-17) for 569.075. Refined subsection 2 note to match 'found guilty' and permissive civil remedies.

headings.title: Elements of tampering in the first degree
headings.reviewNote: Defines first degree tampering as causing substantial service interruption to a utility or institution, or unlawfully possessing or operating a motor vehicle.

headings.title: Admissibility of prior acts or below-value acquisition
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes admission of evidence of prior vehicle offenses or below-value acquisition to prove requisite knowledge in vehicle tampering prosecutions.

headings.title: Class D felony classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies tampering in the first degree as a class D felony.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all three subsections and effective date (1-01-17) for 569.080. Verified accuracy of first-degree tampering elements, evidentiary admissibility rules, and class D felony classification.

headings.title: Definition of critical infrastructure facility
headings.reviewNote: Defines critical infrastructure facility across operational or under-construction energy, water, transport, telecommunications, and industrial sites.

headings.title: Elements and class B misdemeanor classification
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of purposely trespassing on property containing a critical infrastructure facility without permission as a class B misdemeanor.

headings.title: Exemption for constitutionally or statutorily protected conduct
headings.reviewNote: Exempts conduct protected under the United States Constitution, Missouri Constitution, or applicable federal or state laws and rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all three subsections, 2026 merger notes (S.B. 903/1421), and severability clause (§ 1.1010) for 569.086. Verified accuracy of critical infrastructure definition, class B misdemeanor trespass, and constitutional/statutory exemption.

headings.title: Elements of tampering in the second degree
headings.reviewNote: Defines second degree tampering covering property inconvenience, vehicle joyriding, utility tampering, or meter diversion.

headings.title: Permissible inference from meter tampering and service receipt
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes trial courts to submit an inference of a violation against persons receiving direct benefits from tampered utility meters.

headings.title: Classification and felony enhancements for repeat violations
headings.reviewNote: Classifies second degree tampering as a class A misdemeanor, enhanced to class E for repeat meter tampering and class D for prior vehicle theft or tampering.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all three subsections and effective date (1-01-17) for 569.090. Verified accuracy of second-degree tampering elements, permissible meter-tampering inference, and misdemeanor/felony classifications.

headings.title: Elements of tampering with computer data
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of knowingly and without authorization modifying, destroying, disclosing, or taking computer data, programs, or passwords.

headings.title: Classification and class E felony enhancement
headings.reviewNote: Classifies tampering with computer data as a class A misdemeanor, enhanced to class E felony if committed to defraud or obtain property worth $750 or more.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections, effective date (1-01-17), and § 537.525 civil cross-reference for 569.095. Verified accuracy of computer data tampering elements and class A/E penalties.

headings.title: Elements of tampering with computer equipment
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of knowingly and without authorization modifying, destroying, damaging, or taking computer equipment, systems, or networks.

headings.title: Classification and graduated felony enhancements based on value or damage
headings.reviewNote: Classifies offense as a class A misdemeanor, elevated to class E felony for fraud/obtaining property worth $750+ or damage of $750+, and class D felony for damage of $25,000+.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections, effective date (1-01-17), and § 537.525 civil cross-reference for 569.097. Clarified subsection 2 note regarding $750 fraud/property value and $750/$25,000 damage thresholds.

headings.title: Elements of tampering with computer users
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of knowingly and without authorization accessing systems or denying computer system services to authorized users.

headings.title: Classification and class E felony enhancement
headings.reviewNote: Classifies tampering with computer users as a class A misdemeanor, enhanced to class E felony for fraud schemes involving $750 or more.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections, effective date (1-01-17), and § 537.525 civil cross-reference for 569.099. Verified accuracy of computer user tampering elements and class A/E penalties.

headings.title: Elements of property damage in the first degree
headings.reviewNote: Defines first degree property damage for damage exceeding $750, insurance fraud, vehicle burglary damage, or teller machine damage.

headings.title: Classification and graduated felony penalties
headings.reviewNote: Establishes felony penalties ranging from class E to class B depending on target, officer targeting, motor vehicle burglary, or teller machine damage.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and history notes for 569.100. Verified accuracy of first-degree property damage elements and graduated class E/D/C/B felony penalties.

headings.title: Elements of damage of a critical infrastructure facility
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of purposely damaging equipment or recklessly damaging facilities or removing components of a critical infrastructure facility.

headings.title: Classification based on intent and damage amounts
headings.reviewNote: Classifies purposeful damage as class D felony, and reckless damage as class A misdemeanor, class E felony ($750+), or class D felony ($25,000+).

headings.title: Class C felony enhancement for service interruption
headings.reviewNote: Enhances critical infrastructure damage to a class C felony regardless of value if it causes interruption, impairment, or degradation of service.

headings.title: Determination of damage value under section 570.020
headings.reviewNote: Directs that value of damages under the section shall be determined pursuant to section 570.020.

headings.title: Mandatory restitution and tiered community service requirements
headings.reviewNote: Mandates restitution under section 559.105 and tiered community service (100 hours first offense, 200 second, up to 300 third or subsequent).

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all five subsections, 2026 merger notes (S.B. 903/1421), and severability clause (§ 1.1010) for 569.117. Verified accuracy of critical infrastructure damage elements, penalties, § 570.020 valuation, restitution, and tiered community service.

headings.title: Definitions of regulated materials and critical infrastructure facility
headings.reviewNote: Defines copper, brass, aluminum, fiber, or telecommunications material and critical infrastructure facility under section 569.086.

headings.title: Elements of unauthorized possession of regulated materials
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of knowingly possessing regulated metal, fiber, or telecommunications material without statutory authorization.

headings.title: Authorized categories of material possessors
headings.reviewNote: Lists categories of authorized possessors including owners, utilities, carriers, commercial businesses, contractors, recyclers, and agents.

headings.title: Inapplicability of authorization to known unlawfully obtained material
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that statutory authorization does not apply to any person who knows the material was unlawfully obtained.

headings.title: Classification and class D felony enhancements
headings.reviewNote: Classifies unauthorized possession as a class E felony, elevated to class D if unlawfully obtained from a critical infrastructure facility, or for prior convictions or conspiracy.

headings.title: Multiple prosecution authorization subject to section 556.041
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes prosecution under this section and any other applicable provisions of law subject to section 556.041.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all six subsections, 2026 merger notes (S.B. 903/1421), and severability clause (§ 1.1010) for 569.119. Refined subsection 5 note to match exact statutory wording ('unlawfully obtained from a critical infrastructure facility').

headings.title: Elements of property damage in the second degree
headings.reviewNote: Defines second degree property damage as knowingly damaging another's property or damaging property to defraud an insurer.

headings.title: Classification and enhancement for targeting law enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Classifies second degree property damage as a class B misdemeanor, enhanced to class A if targeting a law enforcement officer or relative.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and history notes for 569.120. Verified accuracy of second-degree property damage elements and class B/A misdemeanor classifications.

headings.title: Defense of claim of right based on reasonable belief
headings.reviewNote: Provides that damaging, tampering, or operating property is not an offense if done under a claim of right with reasonable belief of right.

headings.title: Burden of injecting claim of right on defendant
headings.reviewNote: Places the burden of injecting the issue of claim of right upon the defendant.

headings.title: Ineligibility of willful tenant damage to assert claim of right
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits tenants who willfully or wantonly destroy, damage, or remove leased property from injecting the issue of claim of right.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all three subsections and history notes for 569.130. Verified accuracy of claim-of-right defense, defendant injection burden, and willful tenant-damage bar.

headings.title: Statutory title and citation as Crop Protection Act
headings.reviewNote: Designates the section as the Crop Protection Act.

headings.title: Elements of prohibited acts involving crops
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates prohibited acts including intentional crop loss, vandalism, false pretenses, unauthorized entry, theft, and crop destruction.

headings.title: Classification and graduated felony penalties based on crop loss
headings.reviewNote: Classifies crop offenses as class A misdemeanors, elevated to class E ($750), class D ($1,000), class C ($25,000), or class B ($75,000) felonies.

headings.title: Civil cause of action for damaged persons under section 537.353
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a civil cause of action under section 537.353 for any person damaged by a violation of the section.

headings.title: Injunctions and preservation of other legal remedies
headings.reviewNote: Preserves other legal remedies and mandates permanent injunctive relief upon petition by an injured business owner or operator.

headings.title: Department of agriculture investigative authority and law enforcement aid
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director of agriculture to investigate violations and mandates investigative assistance from attorney general and law enforcement.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority, chapter 536 compliance, and nonseverability clause
headings.reviewNote: Grants rulemaking authority subject to chapter 536 and establishes nonseverability between the section and legislative rulemaking review.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all seven subsections, transfer note (formerly § 578.416), and effective date (1-01-17) for 569.132. Tightened subsection 2 title to remove non-statutory phrase 'farm property' and verified remaining headings.

headings.title: Elements of unlawfully entering or defacing a cave or cavern
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of defacing cave surfaces or formations or tampering with cave entrance gates or locks without prior written permission.

headings.title: Restriction against additional enforcement appropriations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits additional legislative appropriations for the enforcement of the section.

headings.title: Exemption for underground mining operations
headings.reviewNote: Exempts vertical or horizontal underground mining operations from the provisions of the section.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies unlawfully entering or defacing a cave or cavern as a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all four subsections, transfer note (formerly § 578.210), effective date (1-01-17), and § 293.620 cross-reference for 569.135. Verified accuracy of cave-defacement elements, appropriations bar, mining exemption, and penalty.

headings.title: Definitions of cave system and sinkhole
headings.reviewNote: Defines cave system and sinkhole based on hydrological connections and subsurface drainage openings.

headings.title: Elements of polluting cave or subsurface waters
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of purposely introducing into caves, sinkholes, or subsurface waters any substance or structure that will or could violate Missouri clean water law.

headings.title: Exemptions for stormwater drainage and underground mining
headings.reviewNote: Exempts natural stormwater drainage, aquifer recharge, irrigation return flow, and underground mining operations from the section.

headings.title: Restriction against additional enforcement appropriations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits additional legislative appropriations for the enforcement of the section.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies polluting cave or subsurface waters as a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all five subsections, transfer note (formerly § 578.215), and effective date (1-01-17) for 569.137. Refined subsection 2 note to reflect 'will or could violate' clean water law.

headings.title: Elements of trespass in the first degree
headings.reviewNote: Defines first degree trespass as knowingly entering or remaining unlawfully in a building, inhabitable structure, or real property.

headings.title: Enclosure or notice requirement for real property trespass
headings.reviewNote: Requires real property to be fenced or notice given by actual communication or posting to constitute first degree trespass.

headings.title: Classification, officer targeting enhancement, and nuclear facility felony
headings.reviewNote: Classifies first degree trespass as class B misdemeanor, elevated to class A for targeting law enforcement and class E felony for nuclear plants.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all three subsections and § 258.200 cross-reference for 569.140. Verified accuracy of first-degree trespass elements, enclosure/notice requirement, and class B/A/E penalties.

headings.title: Elements of trespass in the second degree and absolute liability
headings.reviewNote: Defines second degree trespass as entering unlawfully upon real property of another and establishes it as an absolute liability offense.

headings.title: Infraction classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies trespass in the second degree as an infraction.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections, effective date (1-01-17), § 258.200 cross-reference, and 1980 State v. Neighbors annotation for 569.150. Verified accuracy of second-degree trespass absolute-liability elements and infraction classification.

headings.title: Elements of trespass of a school bus
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of trespass of a school bus as knowingly and unlawfully entering or operating any school bus.

headings.title: Definitions of unlawful entry and unlawful operation
headings.reviewNote: Defines unlawful entry and operation as entry or operation not approved by written school district policy or specific school board approval.

headings.title: Mandatory student behavior policy enforcement on school buses
headings.reviewNote: Requires school districts adopting bus access policies to establish and enforce student behavior policies on school buses.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies trespass of a school bus as a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked all four subsections and effective date (1-01-17) for 569.155. Verified accuracy of school-bus trespass elements, definitions, student behavior policy mandate, and class A misdemeanor penalty.

headings.title: Elements and aggravating factors of burglary in the first degree
headings.reviewNote: Defines first degree burglary as unlawful entry or remaining with intent to commit an offense while armed, causing injury or threat, or non-participant present.

headings.title: Class B felony classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies burglary in the first degree as a class B felony.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections, effective date (1-01-17), and 1998 State v. Crews annotation for 569.160. Verified accuracy of first-degree burglary elements and class B felony classification.

headings.title: Elements of burglary in the second degree
headings.reviewNote: Defines second degree burglary covering unlawful entry into buildings, motor vehicles with intent to steal or commit a felony, or restricted commercial areas.

headings.title: Classification and penalties for vehicle firearms or restricted areas
headings.reviewNote: Classifies offense as class D felony, elevated to class C felony for vehicle firearms, and class B or A misdemeanor for restricted commercial areas.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and 2025 S.B. 71 amendment for 569.170. Verified accuracy of second-degree burglary elements (buildings, motor vehicles, restricted commercial areas) and graduated felony/misdemeanor penalties.

headings.title: Elements of unlawfully gaining entry into motor vehicles
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of lifting door handles or trying locks of successive motor vehicles to gain entry for stealing without owner permission.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies unlawfully gaining entry into motor vehicles as a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and 2025 S.B. 71 history note for 569.175. Verified accuracy of unlawfully gaining entry into successive motor vehicles and class A misdemeanor classification.

headings.title: Elements of possession of burglar's tools
headings.reviewNote: Defines possession of burglar's tools as possessing articles adapted for forcible entry with purpose or knowledge of unlawful forcible entry.

headings.title: Class E felony classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies possession of burglar's tools as a class E felony.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections, effective date (1-01-17), and 1984 State v. Adkins annotation for 569.180. Verified accuracy of burglar's tools elements and class E felony classification.

headings.title: Elements of criminal mischief regarding residential dwellings
headings.reviewNote: Defines criminal mischief as unlawfully detaining, occupying, or trespassing upon a residential dwelling.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor classification
headings.reviewNote: Classifies criminal mischief as a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Checked both subsections and 2024 H.B. 2062 history note for 569.200. Verified accuracy of residential criminal mischief elements and class A misdemeanor classification.
